resources_zooplasyncresource_zooplasyncr: Filament resource class in real-estate-zoopla-filament that provides the admin form, table, and pages for managing Zoopla portal sync records.
services_searchservice_searchservice: Service class in the search module that performs application-wide search, including searching across models and searching users specifically.
sessions_devices_module: Liberu Sessions and Devices, a foundation-category liberu-module package that provides session/device management under the identity.sessions capability.
set_coverage_thresholds: A boilerplate-scripts CLI command that writes measured per-package code coverage thresholds into each repository's tests.yml workflow inputs, raising only.
set_phpstan_levels: A boilerplate-scripts CLI command that writes measured per-package PHPStan levels into each repository's tests.yml workflow inputs, raising only.
settings_filament_module: Liberu Settings Administration, a presentation-category liberu-module package providing the Filament UI for the Liberu Settings module, built on filament/spatie-laravel-settings-plugin.
stat_chart_buildorupdateelements: Chart.js DatasetController method that builds or updates the visual elements for a dataset during a render/update cycle.
stat_chart_computelabelsizes: Chart.js Scale internal method that computes the pixel sizes of axis tick labels using resolved tick font options.
stat_chart_createanimations: Chart.js Animator internal method that creates animation objects for changed option values during an update.
stat_chart_createdescriptors: Chart.js internal method that builds property descriptors used by the options resolver/proxy system.
stat_chart_describe: Chart.js defaults/registry method used to register descriptive metadata for a chart type or component.
stat_chart_dl: A minified Chart.js scale helper used alongside buildTicks for computing tick differences.
stat_chart_drawdataset: Chart.js DatasetController internal method that draws a single dataset onto the canvas.
stat_chart_ee: A minified Chart.js helper used when drawing axis labels and titles.
stat_chart_en: Chart.js time-scale helper that parses and normalizes label timestamps to the start of a time unit.
stat_chart_er: A minified Chart.js internal update helper.
stat_chart_eventhandler: Chart.js Chart internal method that handles and dispatches DOM/canvas events to the appropriate chart elements.
stat_chart_getdatatimestamps: Chart.js time-scale method that collects all parsed timestamp values from visible datasets.
stat_chart_getindexangle: Chart.js radial/polar scale method that computes the angle for a given data index when drawing labels.
stat_chart_getminmax: Chart.js Scale method that determines the minimum and maximum data limits across visible, matching dataset metas.
stat_chart_gr: Chart.js registry helper used to describe and register chart types or plugins.
stat_chart_init: Chart.js Scale/Controller initialization method that sets up context, labels, and parsing before rendering.
stat_chart_linkscales: Chart.js DatasetController method that links a dataset's controller to its associated x/y scales.
stat_chart_lt: A minified Chart.js color helper related to alpha/opacity computation.
stat_chart_mn: Chart.js options-resolver helper that resolves named element options via a created resolver.
stat_chart_mt: Chart.js options-resolver helper that resolves named options through a created resolver, similar to mn().
stat_chart_q: Chart.js Scale internal method involved in computing label rotation and axis offsets.
stat_chart_qs: Chart.js helper that computes line/area segments from matching visible dataset metas.
stat_chart_qt: Chart.js color helper that converts a color to greyscale or adjusts its properties.
stat_chart_register: Chart.js registry method that registers a chart component (controller, scale, or plugin) for use.
stat_chart_resolvedataelementoptions: Chart.js helper that resolves the final style/options for a single data element, accounting for shared options and overflow.
stat_chart_sn: A minified Chart.js helper used for path segment computation with x/y coordinates.
stat_chart_startof: Chart.js time-scale helper that rounds a timestamp down to the start of a given time unit.
stat_chart_stop: Chart.js Animator method that stops and cancels active animations, notifying listeners.
stat_chart_sync: Chart.js DatasetController internal method that keeps chart meta data in sync with push/pop/shift/splice/unshift changes to the underlying data array.
stat_chart_un: A minified Chart.js Scale helper involved in computing label rotation during layout fitting.
stat_chart_updatedatasets: Chart.js Chart method that updates all of the chart's datasets, notifying plugins before and after.
